[dependencies]

before.context: Real Server CPU/kernel; private readonly glibc2.44 closure, not stock glibc2.35 support. Unprivileged host UID mapped to namespace root. SDK envsetup sourced only after 392-file binding PASS. No host governor/sysctl changes.
before.clock: Observed Server wall clock behind local approximately647s; measurements use unchanged monotonic_ns.

after.context: Real Server CPU/kernel; private readonly glibc2.44 closure, not stock glibc2.35 support. Unprivileged host UID mapped to namespace root. SDK envsetup sourced only after 392-file binding PASS. No host governor/sysctl changes.
after.clock: Observed Server wall clock behind local approximately647s; measurements use unchanged monotonic_ns.

environment.network: Native same-host loopback; no injected RTT/loss; both peers in one executable
environment.load: One measured process at a time; case-specific bounded concurrency
environment.reuse: Case-defined: persistent transport/TLS and H1/H2 reuse versus explicit fresh connections
environment.TLS: Static archive-bound AWS-LC baseline 5.5.0 versus candidate 5.11.0
environment.resource_boundary: Whole native workload process /proc RSS/threads/fds includes runtime and both peers; not Wirestack-exclusive memory
environment.cjpm:
CHECKOUT_MASK=PASS; entire snapshot repository hidden by readonly child mount
Cangjie Project Manager: 1.1.3
